SINDHUJA SS 
 
Blood Group Detection using Fingerprint
 
 
Mitra AI - AI-Powered Government Scheme Assistant
 
AI-Based Microplastic Detection System – PALS InnoWah Project
 
Designed adeeplearning–basedbiometricsystemto predict blood groups from fingerprint images using Python, OpenCV,
and CNN architectures. Implemented preprocessing, feature extraction, and supervised model training to classify fingerprint
patterns. Evaluated model performance using accuracy and confusion matrix metrics, enabling automated healthcare-
oriented biometric analysis.
Developed an IoT-enabledmicroplasticdetectionplatform usingRaspberry Pi5 and deep learning models for automated
water quality analysis. Implemented multi-angle microscopic image capture and API-based communication with a Roboflow
ML model for real-time detection. Trained and deployed a ResNet-50 convolutional neural network using transfer learning for
microscopic image classification of microplastics. Built a Flask backend and web dashboard for live visualization of detection
resultsand confidence metrics.
Developed and integrated Sarvam AI to enable multilingual government scheme recommendations across 21 Indian
languages using natural language queries. Implemented Aadhaar document OCR with Tesseract.js to automatically extract
user details and reduce manual data entry. Built a voice-to-text input system using the Web Speech API to capture user
information such as age, income, occupation, and location for efficient government scheme discovery.
